note: What a server sends to say a unit gained experience. The header names no object: a server writes zero.

fields.name: unit
fields.note: The unit granted it, one with a mind, such as a champion or a minion. A client does nothing for a unit it does not know.

fields.name: amount
fields.note: How much. A client shows a value below zero or from 100000 up as well.

revisions.note: It changes no unit's experience: a client only floats the amount as text over the unit, where the player's floating-text settings allow.

fields.name: unit
fields.note: The unit granted it, a champion. A client fails for any other unit it holds, and does nothing for a unit it does not know.

fields.name: amount
fields.note: How much. A client shows a value below zero or from 100000 up as well.

revisions.note: It changes no unit's experience: a client only floats the amount as text over the unit, where the player's floating-text settings allow.
Where the unit is the client's own champion below its highest level, a client also shows the amount on its experience display.
